title: Claude Sonnet 4 now supports 1M tokens of context
translatedTitle: Claude Sonnet 4 现已支持 100 万 token 上下文
subtitle: Claude Sonnet 4 now supports up to 1 million tokens of context—a 5x increase that lets you process entire codebases, synthesize extensive document sets, and build agents that maintain coherence across hundreds of tool calls.
